title: Find AlphaAgent Project Details
scenario: You want to learn more about the AlphaAgent project to understand its architecture and find its GitHub repository.
goal: Locate the AlphaAgent project card and identify its GitHub repository link.
successCriteria: User locates AlphaAgent and opens its GitHub repository link.

title: Download Resume
scenario: A recruiter is viewing your portfolio and wants to download your resume for offline review.
goal: Locate and access the resume download functionality.

title: Search and Read Blog Article
scenario: You're interested in reading about a specific topic covered in the blog section.
goal: Navigate to the blog section, use the tag filter to find a relevant article, and read it.
successCriteria: User filters by a tag and opens a blog article to read

title: Toggle Dark Mode
scenario: You're viewing the portfolio in light mode and prefer dark mode for better readability.
goal: Switch the portfolio to dark mode using either the header button or keyboard shortcut.
successCriteria: User successfully toggles dark mode (via button or 'D' key)

title: Submit Contact Form
scenario: A potential employer wants to find the best way to contact you.
goal: Locate the contact form, identify its required fields, and inspect its validation without sending a message.
successCriteria: User identifies the required fields and can correct an invalid entry from the form feedback.
